sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: FlowSequential container with explicitly chosen two registered child instances Sigmoid then Reverse; not a source training configuration.

sourceFacts: Registration order controls direct traversal; inverse uses reversed(self._modules.values()) and asks each same instance for its inverse branch.
Each component returns a feature tensor and a logdet tensor. Feature composition and logdet accumulation are two distinct streams.
Selected Sigmoid/Reverse components are an illustrative constructor profile, not a claim that an upstream callsite instantiates this exact pair.
Reverse perm and inv_perm are ordinary NumPy attributes; no learned parameters. Their scalar Jacobian is zero.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
